## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 The discourse shares virtually its entire poetic structure (§0.1–8.1) with its immediate predecessor, the *Paṭhamakaraṇīyavimānavatthu* (Vv 56), alongside extensive formulaic and verse overlap with other poems in the collection, including the *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), *Dvārapālavimānavatthu* (Vv 55), *Caturitthivimānavatthu* (Vv 45), and *Dutiyasūcivimānavatthu* (Vv 59) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
